question: Which of the following diseases is caused by a parasite?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Malaria__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Malaria is caused by a parasite that usually infects a certain type of mosquito that feeds on humans**__.

 __
 
• The parasites, spread by the female Anopheles mosquito, deposit sporozoites in the skin of the human host.
 
• World Malaria Day 2020 is being celebrated by the World Health Organization (WHO) on 25 April with the theme 'Zero Malaria Start with Me'.
 
• Chloroquine is a drug used to prevent and treat malaria, primarily in areas where malaria is sensitive to its effects.​​​​​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Goiter** is a swelling of the thyroid gland that causes a lump in the front of the neck.

 
 
• The lump will move up and down when you swallow.
 
• The thyroid gland is a small butterfly-shaped gland in the neck, just in front of the windpipe (trachea).
 
 
 
• **Pneumonia **is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
 
 
• The air sacs may fill with fluid or pus (purulent material), causing cough with phlegm or pus, fever, chills, and difficulty breathing.
 
• A variety of organisms, including bacteria, viruses, and fungi, can cause pneumonia.
 
 
 
• **Plague **is a disease that affects humans and other mammals.
 
 
• **It is caused by the bacterium, Yersinia pestis.**
 
• Humans usually get plague after being bitten by a rodent flea that is carrying the plague bacterium or by handling an animal infected with plague.
